name: comp-220
blurb: Select for status values with colored indicator dots.
description: A select where each option shows a colored circular SVG dot followed by a status label. Dots use semantic colors (green, blue, amber, gray, red).
use_when: Picking workflow or task statuses where visual color coding aids recognition.
avoid_when: Simple text-only selections or when color alone is insufficient for a11y.
a11y: Dots are aria-hidden; text labels provide meaning.
